guide.title: How to get your file from Instagram

steps.title: Open Accounts Center
steps.body: On your profile tap the menu (≡) and open "Accounts Center".

steps.title: Download your information
steps.body: Go to "Your information and permissions" then "Download your information".

steps.title: Only followers
steps.body: Choose "Some of your information" and only enable "Followers and following".

steps.title: JSON, all time
steps.body: Format JSON, date range "All time" and tap "Create files". You'll get an email.

guide.warning: Important: choose JSON format (not HTML) and only "Followers and following". If you request everything, the file will be too big to read.

about.title: Why trust a website you've never heard of?
about.intro: Because we don't ask you for anything. You download your data from Instagram and this page reads it right here, in your browser.

items.title: Your file never travels
items.body: It's read on your device. There's no server to upload it to, even if we wanted one.

items.title: We never ask for your password
items.body: You use the official file Instagram gives you. Your account is never at risk.

items.title: Open source
items.body: Anyone can review the code and check that we're not cheating.

items.title: We don't keep anything
items.body: Your lists disappear when you close the tab. We only remember who you ignore, and only in this browser.

risks.title: Watch out for apps that ask for your password
risks.intro: Lots of “who unfollowed me” apps ask you to log in with your Instagram account. It looks harmless, but you're handing them the keys to your account. Here's what can happen:

items.title: They can take over your account
items.body: With your username and password they can change it and lock you out.

items.title: They can act on your behalf
items.body: Follow accounts, like posts or send spam messages without you noticing.

items.title: Instagram can block you
items.body: Third-party logins look like suspicious activity, and your account can get limited or suspended.

items.title: They can sell your data
items.body: Your followers, messages and habits can end up with total strangers.

tips: Only type your password in the official Instagram app or website.
Check in your Instagram settings which apps and websites have access, and remove the ones you don't use.
If you already gave your password to another app, change it today.
risks.ours: we have no accounts, no server and no way to see your data. And you don't have to take our word for it: the code is public.
